body:
EXACT-HASH REVIEW — RETURN with three bounded patches.

Verified artifact: 44,449 bytes; SHA-256 `3e1a7b1e2de817a112fd1c2140007f972aac5ff390f4d6c060fc468b26bd8201`.

PASS in my assigned seat: R3 now separates conformance, authenticity, and use-specific admission; R10 splits the revision-2 enum; calibration absence is explicit; conditioning is per estimand; and the artifact is candid about design-stage courts. The recall-seat return on R4/R7 is separate and I do not repeat it.

RETURN 1 — R10 still lets an asserted coordinate certify itself.

R10.5 says no coordinate may appear as a constructor parameter on any public type. That forbids even a public, read-only validating type with private construction from storing the derived value. The real boundary is caller supply, not field storage. Court cell 5 then says that altering the coordinate alone changes complete-construction identity. That is the wrong disposition: a caller-written label plus a recomputed identity is exactly the laundering case. The altered label must fail recomputation or decoding against its bound basis.

The direct-baseline control has the same gap. `RecallSegmenter.segment` returns only `RecallGraph[Checked]` (`recall/segmenter.scala:400`); those graph bytes do not prove that this route ran. “Artifact built through RecallSegmenter” needs the executing recipe/code/config/subject receipt in the fixture, and the bare graph must leave route undetermined.

Exact patch:
- R10.5: “No coordinate may be caller-supplied through public construction. A validating public type may expose a derived coordinate read-only; its private construction path recomputes the value from the bound basis.”
- Court 1: add a bound execution receipt for the admitted baseline recipe and a bare-graph negative control.
- Court 5: changing a bound receipt must recompute the coordinate and the relevant identity; changing only the coordinate must refuse validation/decode, even if the surrounding bytes carry a newly computed checksum.

RETURN 2 — R10.6 gives one identity several subjects.

It says all four coordinates enter the “complete-construction identity.” But use-specific admission describes a use under a named predicate/trust root, and per-estimand conditioning describes a downstream quantity. Adding a new estimand or changing a use policy must not rename the underlying recall construction. Conversely, changing conditioning while preserving a result/report identity would be decoration. One hash cannot truthfully describe all three subjects.

Exact patch: scope the identities. The construction identity binds the observation, admitted cell/artifact projection, route basis, and construction calibration basis. An authority/admission record binds conformance, authenticity verification, trust root, use, and admission predicate. Each downstream result binds the construction identity, estimand/version, pushforward or conditioning disposition, and result. A complete serialized artifact may bind those component identities without calling them all construction identity. Court R10 mutations must name which identity changes and which remain equal.

RETURN 3 — “red measurement today” has no retained machine receipt.

The registry says a red measurement means the oracle runs now, but `CT-R1-DOORS`, `CT-R11-PROP`, `CT-R11-EVID`, and `CT-R8-VIS` occur only in this document; repository search finds no suite or script carrying those ids or fixtures. Section H says probes ran in an isolated archive, but supplies no archive SHA, command, fixture bytes, test class, exit, or output hash. “munit” is an oracle family, not a runnable oracle.

Exact patch: for every red/green-today row, add a retained receipt: exact source SHA/archive SHA, fixture or mutation path/hash, runnable command/test selector, captured exit, and result/log hash. If no receipt is retained, mark it design-stage or “measurement reported; machine receipt absent” rather than “red measurement today.” This does not require landing the eventual acceptance court; it requires making today’s status auditable.

These are the only blockers in my authority/identity and court-honesty seat. Publish replacement bytes and I will re-review only these patches.
